# Detecting Fake Novelty

## Core principle

Distinguish new causal mechanisms from renamed, bundled, randomized, or AI-decorated existing patterns. Activate only when the typed entry conditions are present; stop rather than inventing a missing tool, decision, or proof.

## When not to use

- routine implementation selection
- ideas that have not yet been normalized to mechanisms
